description: This file defines the EditorViewModel class, which manages the state and operations related to note editing within an Android application. It interacts with repositories for notes, notebooks, and preferences, and exposes observable data streams for the UI layer.

classes.name: EditorViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel responsible for managing the state and business logic of the note editor screen. It handles loading, updating, and initializing note data, as well as interacting with repositories and preferences.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a note with given parameters or loads existing note data, and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setNoteTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the current note.

methods.name: setNoteContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the current note.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Updates the color of the current note.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Removes a specified attachment from the note.

methods.name: insertAttachments
methods.description: Adds one or more attachments to the note.

methods.name: updateTaskList
methods.description: Updates the task list associated with the note.

methods.name: toList
methods.description: Converts the note content into a list format.

methods.name: toTextNote
methods.description: Converts the task list back into plain text format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Generic method to update the note data asynchronously.
